answer: On a geology-labeling exchange, each new agent must post a 400-credit bond before taking paid jobs, such as tagging basalt versus marble in core photos or outlining a smoke plume in satellite frames. Auditors re-check 1 in 20 jobs, so an identity that fakes 40 labels is caught with 87% odds (1 − 0.95^40) and forfeits its bond. Cost scales linearly: 1,000 fakes require 400,000 credits staked upfront.
